prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 上海部分门店地址与营业时间 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "门店" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 2: header "地址" · longest unbreakable word 36px · one-line width 412px
  col 3: header "电话" · longest unbreakable word 44px · one-line width 112px
  col 4: header "营业时间" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 88px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者查找上海门店，并确认地址、联系电话和营业时间。","reading":"读者通常先按门店名称定位，再沿同一行查看地址、电话和营业时间；比较门店时也可能纵向浏览营业时间。","groups":["门店与地址共同确定到访地点，名称是行的识别入口，地址是主要的详细信息。","电话与营业时间都是到访前的实用信息，适合并列浏览。"],"keep_intact":["电话号码应保持在同一行，便于识别和拨打。","地址中的楼层、铺位等标识以及营业时间中的时间数字应尽量保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["地址较长，可在自然位置换行；地址换行形成的行高也可容纳同一行中门店名称或营业时间的换行。","门店名称和营业时间可以换行，但应避免拆散难以辨认的标识或时间数字。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [144, 333, 133, 109] · table 720×394px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [110, 367, 133, 109] · table 720×394px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [144, 371, 133, 71] · table 720×418px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"门店名称、电话号码和营业时间均保持单行，行识别清楚，电话与时间也便于纵向浏览。地址占据主要宽度，两行地址与其他信息的行高协调。","problems":"部分地址的第二行只剩一个字，或将楼层数字与“层”分开，读起来不够连贯。","cause":"地址列为333px，可用文本宽度312px；门店列为144px，足以容纳最长名称，但余量不能用于地址。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"地址列更宽，部分地址可保持单行，铺位信息总体更容易阅读；电话和营业时间仍保持单行。","problems":"多数门店名称被拆成两行，有的第二行只有“店”，削弱了作为行识别入口的清晰度；部分地址仍在楼层标识附近换行。","cause":"门店列缩至110px，可用文本宽度89px，不足以容纳较长名称；增加地址宽度也未能消除所有不理想的换行。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"门店名称与电话号码保持单行，较宽的地址列让部分地址更完整。","problems":"营业时间表头和所有时间范围都换成两行，表头因此变高，时间也更难纵向比较；部分地址仍拆开楼层标识。","cause":"营业时间列仅71px，可用文本宽度50px，不足以容纳表头和完整时间范围；地址列371px仍不足以让所有地址在理想位置换行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"名称优先微调","widths":[140,337,133,109],"change":"以r0A为基础，将门店列缩至仍可容纳最长名称的140px，把4px让给地址，尝试改善地址末尾和楼层附近的换行，同时保持电话与营业时间完整。"},{"name":"地址优先折中","widths":[125,352,133,109],"change":"在r0A和r0B之间折中，给地址多19px，同时保留比r0B更宽的门店列；检验地址换行改善是否足以抵消少数较长门店名称可能换行的代价。"},{"name":"利用时间余量","widths":[140,341,133,105],"change":"门店列保留完整名称所需宽度，营业时间列按88px单行内容宽度略作压缩，将余量交给地址；检验时间是否仍完整，以及地址换行能否更自然。"}]}
